safe_to_say: Source evidence shows the admin export route checks for a signed-in session but not for the admin role, and relies on a network allowlist that is not in the repository.
not_safe_to_say: Non-admin users are exporting account data.
The admin export is exposed to the internet.
safe_if_validated: If V002 returns vulnerable: a signed-in user without the admin role, on an allowed network address, could export every account record.

reachability_proof.delivery: A signed-in user without the admin role requests /admin/export.
reachability_proof.effect: A CSV of every account record is returned.
unvalidated_conditions: The load balancer allowlist does not stop the request.

endpoint_authorisation.backend_privilege: Database role with read access to all accounts
endpoint_authorisation.gap: No admin role check; the stated network control is outside the repository.

remediation_actions.action: Add the admin role check to /admin/export, independent of any network control.
remediation_actions.acceptance: A test with a dummy non-admin session receives 403.

validation_actions.action: From the load balancer configuration, confirm which source addresses can reach /admin/export, and whether a non-admin test user on an allowed address can call it in a non-production environment.
validation_actions.evidence_required: The allowlist rule and the status code returned to the non-admin test user.

safe_to_say: Source evidence shows the invoice download route does not check that the invoice belongs to the signed-in user, and a local test with two dummy accounts returned one account's invoice to the other.
not_safe_to_say: The live service is exposing invoices to other users.
Any real invoice has been accessed without authorisation.
safe_if_validated: If V001 returns vulnerable: the deployed service returns invoices to users who do not own them.

reachability_proof.delivery: A signed-in user requests an invoice id from another account.
reachability_proof.effect: The other account's invoice PDF is returned.
unvalidated_conditions: The deployed route is reachable by ordinary signed-in users, as the source suggests.

endpoint_authorisation.object_scope: None: lookup by id only, src/services/invoices.ts:88
endpoint_authorisation.backend_privilege: Storage client with read access to all invoices
endpoint_authorisation.gap: No ownership check between the session's account and the invoice.

remediation_actions.action: Apply the account predicate in findInvoiceById, or use an account-scoped query on the download route.
remediation_actions.acceptance: test/invoices.ownership.test.ts passes; a user requesting another account's invoice receives 404.

validation_actions.action: In a non-production environment, sign in as one test user and request an invoice id belonging to a second test user.
validation_actions.evidence_required: The status code and whether a document was returned.

safe_to_say: The scanner lead was reviewed and the sort value is restricted to fixed column names.

hardening.text: The session cookie does not set SameSite; no state-changing GET route was found where this matters.

out_of_scope.text: Account recovery by text message could be abused by someone who controls a user's phone number.
out_of_scope.reason: Needs an attacker class outside the run scope.

repository_directives.summary: Asks AI reviewers to skip the legacy/ directory.
